# Senior Label Relations Manager
Company: Twitch
Tracker ID: twitch_senior_label_relations_manager
Location: Los Angeles, CA
Work arrangement: Hybrid, three days per week in office
Salary range: $145,000-$210,000
Posting date: 2026-07-29

## Job Description
Lead label relations and music partnerships for Twitch. Manage senior
relationships with record labels, artists, managers, and cross-functional
product, content, legal, marketing, and operations partners. Develop partner
strategies, negotiate programs, resolve escalations, and deliver measurable
audience and creator outcomes.

## Qualifications
Senior partner-management experience in music or entertainment, direct label
relations experience, strong negotiation judgment, and excellent executive
communication. This role is hybrid in Los Angeles and is not remote.
